title: Coherence of a normalized clopen scalar comparison
statement: Let X be a scheme and j_i:Y_i→X a finite pairwise disjoint clopen cover. Use the actual small pro-etale module sheaves, scalar extension presentations p_a and their normalized successive compositor n, exact restrictions r_i and r_D,i, canonical cochain computation morphisms c_a(P), normalized identity units, and scalar comparison interfaces of [def-pur-clopen-derived-scalar-comparison-data]. Fix arbitrary p,n,q,m, identity units U,V and a comparison family d satisfying sections, degree, representative, computed, extended and unique. Then Coherence(j_i,n,m_i,U,V_i,d_i) holds for every i: for all composable coefficient maps a:R→S and b:S→T, the two paths comparing restriction of successive scalar extension with scalar extension by a_i≫b_i agree, both ordinarily and in the derived category, after the canonical functor.map_comp equality transport. Their ordinary common map sends z⊗(s⊗x) to (b_i(s)z)⊗x. For identity coefficient maps the derived and ordinary comparisons commute with U,V after functor.map_id transport. All maps are linear over the target component coefficient ring.

proof.text: Prove ordinary composition by canceling the inverse ambient compositor. By the normalized extension/restriction adjunction, it suffices to test tensors 1 tensor x. The comparison sections formulas, naturality of the adjunction unit, and both compositor tensor formulas then identify both sides. Functor.map_comp transport preserves these tensors. The general composite-sections formula follows directly from ordinary_hom and Comparison.sections. The ordinary identity equation follows from the same tensor extensionality, Comparison.sections and the two Units.sections formulas.

For a coefficient ring R, use the K-flat resolution theorem: every complex K admits a quasi-isomorphism P to K with P K-flat and flat terms. Localization.natTrans_ext reduces equality of derived natural transformations to complexes. Precompose the equality at K by the invertible image of Q(P to K), and naturality reduces it to equality at Q P. Flatness and K-flatness of each component restriction follow from clopen_total_tensor_kflat_detection.

Package each side of the derived composition equation as a natural transformation from successive scalar extension followed by restriction to restriction followed by composite scalar extension. Apply fixed-model composition with the proved ordinary composition equation, and extend by the preceding naturality argument. Do the same for the two identity paths using fixed-model identity and the proved ordinary multiplication equation. Evaluate the resulting natural-transformation equalities at an arbitrary derived object and assemble all five fields of Coherence.

lean.statement:
theorem clopen_scalar_comparison_coherence
    (X : Scheme.{t}) (I : Type w) [Finite I] (Y : I → Scheme.{t})
    (j : ∀ i, Y i ⟶ X) [∀ i, IsOpenImmersion (j i)] [∀ i, IsClosedImmersion (j i)]
    (hd : Pairwise (fun i k ↦ Disjoint (Set.range (j i)) (Set.range (j k))))
    (hc : ∀ x : X, ∃ i, x ∈ Set.range (j i))
    (p : Presentations.{t, u} X)
    (n : Normalization.{t + 1, t, max u (t + 1), max (u + 1) (t + 2)}
      (C := X.ProEt) (J := topology X) (hD := derived.{t, u} X) @p)
    (q : ∀ i, Presentations.{t, u} (Y i))
    (m : ∀ i, Normalization.{t + 1, t, max u (t + 1), max (u + 1) (t + 2)}
      (C := (Y i).ProEt) (J := topology (Y i)) (hD := derived.{t, u} (Y i))
      (fun {R S} a ↦ q i (R := R) (S := S) a))
    (U : Units.{t, u} @p)
    (V : ∀ i, Units.{t, u} (fun {R S} a ↦ q i (R := R) (S := S) a))
    (d : ∀ i, Comparison.{t, u} (j i) @p
      (fun {R S} a ↦ q i (R := R) (S := S) a))
    (hnorm : ∀ i, (d i).sections ∧ (d i).degree ∧ (d i).representative ∧
      (d i).computed ∧ (d i).extended ∧ (d i).unique) :
    ∀ i, Coherence.{t, u} (j i) n (m i) U (V i) (d i)
